title: Add new products
steps: As the owner, say "We are now selling matcha mochi and chocolate mochi, both at $3 each."
expected: Both products are added as separate items at $3 each and shown as available.

title: Change a product's price
steps: Say "Jasmine milk tea is now $7 each." Use a product from your own catalog if it doesn't have jasmine milk tea.
expected: The existing product's price changes to $7. No duplicate product is created and the old price isn't kept.

title: Retire a product
steps: Say "We are no longer selling strawberry mochi." Use a product from your own catalog if needed.
expected: The product is marked as no longer available (or removed) and the other products are unchanged.

title: Ambiguous or unknown product
steps: Say "Mochi is now $4" when more than one mochi is in the catalog.
Say "Retire the taro latte" for a product that isn't in the catalog.
expected: It asks which mochi you mean instead of guessing, and says the taro latte isn't in the catalog instead of creating or changing something.

title: Catalog changes reach customers
steps: After R2.1–R2.3, open the chat and choose Visitor.
Ask about the new mochi, the jasmine milk tea price and the strawberry mochi.
expected: The customer side offers the new mochi at $3, quotes jasmine milk tea at $7, and says strawberry mochi isn't available.
